snippet.title: WHO'S HUNGRY? TEASER - WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3664160/Whos_Hungry/

After a robot invasion that wiped out most humans from existence, a
human calls to DELIVERYCIOUS, one of the few food delivering services left.
You, a Delibot from the same company, must venture to another planet to deliver your food. Explore a kilometric building where all kinds of bots will try to steal your food!
